title: pilot pulse trajectory and staffing slate
body:
OVERVIEW:
This doc tracks the pilot-phase trajectory for the upcoming product ops feature set (traffic shaping + low-latency model swap). Purpose is to consolidate metric targets, staffing rota, and a compact readiness checklist that the ops & product teams can use during 0-100k request ramp. This is an operational working sheet — expect iterative edits and short-hand notes.

PURPOSE / USE-CASES:
- Primary: provide a single-pane status for pilot health and go/no-go signals (SLO burns, error rates, cost per 1k tokens).
- Secondary: run quick what-if staffing scenarios (if traffic doubles, who folds in).
- Tertiary: document contingency playbooks and escalation owners for first 72 hours.

SCOPE:
- Pilot region: us-west-2 (initial), eu-west-1 (shadow).
- Capacity: Dedicated pool (8x A10G equiv), burst to hosted if needed.
- Components: routing policy, prefix cache, canary model variant, circuit breakers, rollout UI.

KEY METRICS (minimum viable watchlist):
- SLO_latency_p50_ms: target=110, threshold_warn=160, thresh_fail=250
- SLO_latency_p95_ms: target=220, threshold_warn=320, thresh_fail=500
- Error_rate_5m: target<0.5%, warn=0.8%, critical=1.5%
- Cost_per_1k_tokens: target<$0.17, warn<$0.25, critical>$0.35
- KV_cache_hit_ratio: target>62%, warn>50%
- Model_swap_success_rate: target>99.5% per rollout batch

(Quick reference table below for handoffs — copy into sheet if needed)
Feature | Owner | Expected Launch Window | Acceptance Gate | Current Status
Traffic shaping | Jordan Park | 2026-01-15 -> 2026-02-05 | SLO p95 < 300ms under 50% load | in_progress
Model swap canary | Evan Li | 2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-18 | 99% requests served by fallback w/in 2s | blocked (infra)
KV cache priming | Riley Thompson | 2026-01-20 -> 2026-01-28 | cache hit >60% for primer cohort | done
Rollout UI route map | Anika Bose | 2026-02-05 -> 2026-02-22 | route-level tracing enabled | in_review

STAFFING ROTA & SURGE PLAN (quick scenarios):
- Normal pilot day (expected 50-250 rps): 1 oncall product-ops, 1 SRE oncall, 1 infra engineer on pager standby (30m to respond).
- Surge (250-1k rps sustained for 30m): escalate to 2 SREs + 1 serving-runtime; product-ops enters war room (Samira lead).
- Critical (>=1% error and p95>500ms): invoke rapid fallback to hosted pool (activation script id: GH#89), page Eng-Director.
Notes: create overlap shifts for first 72h: 8am-12pm & 12pm-4pm coverage, night bin = SRE follow-up only.

READINESS CHECKLIST (tickbox style):
- [ ] Canary traffic policy created & tested in staging (route: pilot/traffic-2026
- [ ] Rollback scripts validated and smoke-tested on staging cluster
- [ ] Cost meters wired into console (per-route cost, token-level)
- [ ] Alert rules pre-baked: p95>300ms; error_rate_5m>0.8%; cost_threshold_alert
- [ ] On-call runbook uploaded to PagerDuty (link in linked_artifacts)
- [ ] KMS keys available for private logs and rotation tested
- [ ] Customer beta cohort seeded (50 orgs) and PK sampling enabled
- [ ] Surge staffing roster published for first 10 days
- [ ] Rollout UI: canary -> percentage controls present and gated
- [ ] KV priming script id & data seed location recorded

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (final go/no-go):
- Duration: 72h continuous pilot without critical SLO breach for primary orgs AND automated fallbacks exercised once.
- Metrics: p95 latency below 300ms for peak 95th percentile across the pilot cohort for 48 of 72 hours.
- Stability: error_rate_5m < 0.8% and any incidents resolved under 60 minutes for P1 within the 72h window.
- Cost: average cost_per_1k_tokens remains <0.25 across sample traffic.

RISKS & MITIGATIONS (short-form):
- Risk: KV cache warm-up fails for varied prompts -> Mitigation: run primer variations, add on-the-fly priming lambda and increase cache TTLs temporarily.
- Risk: Model swap causes OOMs on older GPU nodes -> Mitigation: auto-fallback policy to smaller model variant + drain node; pre-validate model mem footprint in staging.
- Risk: Unexpected spike from external integration test -> Mitigation: hard-rate-limit external IPs, throttle to 10rps per integration key.

OPERATIONAL RUNS & SIMULATIONS (to schedule before go):
- Synthetic surge (1hr): 2x expected peak with degraded kv_hit (simulate cache miss) -> check fallback time and cost delta. Owner: Riley.
- Headroom smoke (30m): force model swap at 25% traffic and validate swap_success_rate. Owner: Evan.
- Incident playbook dry-run (tabletop, 60m): oncall walks through P1 resolution steps. Owner: Samira.

QUICK ACTIONS (current):
- Jordan: finish traffic policy e2e tests by 2026-02-10.
- Evan: unblock infra mem limits (PR #89) and post estimate by 2026-02-06.
- Riley: upload primer dataset and confirm KV hit ratio in staging by 2026-02-04.
- Anika: finalize rollout UI acceptance tests and trace links by 2026-02-12.

MEETING CADENCE & COMM CHECKS:
- Daily 15-min pilot standup (first 10 days) at 09:30 PT — focus on metric delta and blockers.
- War room escalation call only if critical gates breached.
- Weekly retro to capture metric regressions and cost learnings.

NOTES TO SELF / TODOS (informal):
- Keep short logs of any manual overrides in the first 24h.
- If cost per 1k >0.30 consistently, pause canary ramp and export trace logs for model-level token costs.
- Consider adding a lightweight reranking fallback if large prompt sizes cause latency tail.

ATTACHMENTS / REFERENCES:
- Staging test plan: link in linked_artifacts.
- Runbook template: confluence path above.
- Incident template: use PROD incident template (Confluence).

END (working doc)
